# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We as contributors and maintainers pledge to make participation in our community a respectful, welcoming, and harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, experience level, nationality, ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, or any other personal characteristic.

Our goal is to build a friendly and collaborative open source community.

## Our Standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment include:

- Being respectful and constructive.
- Accepting constructive feedback gracefully.
- Being patient with new contributors.
- Helping others learn.
- Focusing on what is best for the project.
- Assuming good intentions whenever possible.

Examples of unacceptable behavior include:

- Harassment or discrimination.
- Personal attacks or insults.
- Trolling or intentionally disruptive behavior.
- Publishing private information without permission.
- Spam or unrelated promotional content.
- Any conduct that could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional environment.

## Responsibilities

Project maintainers are responsible for:

- Clarifying and enforcing this Code of Conduct.
- Taking appropriate and fair corrective action when necessary.
- Maintaining a welcoming environment for contributors.

## Enforcement

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, please report it by opening a private communication with the project maintainer.

All reports will be handled confidentially whenever possible.

## Enforcement Guidelines

Maintainers may take actions including:

- Warning contributors.
- Requesting changes in behavior.
- Removing inappropriate comments or content.
- Temporarily or permanently restricting participation in the project.

The response will depend on the severity and frequency of the behavior.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within:

- GitHub Issues
- Pull Requests
- Discussions
- Any other official project communication channels
